_doc: Tuning that is not a row of another file (PLAN §1.6). One top-level block per system; a milestone adds its own block and never edits another's (M4 raids, M6 mana regen, M7 town). Times in ticks (20 a second).

day._doc: The day clock lives in the sim (M3). daylight is 20 at night and 255 by day, ramping over two hours at dawn (5-7) and dusk (18-20).

sight._doc: Fog of war (§0.10), worked out in the worker every `every` ticks (js/world/fog.js). Quarter-res values: smoke at or above `smokeBlocks` hides a spot; at night (daylight below `darkBelow`) only spots with light at or above `litAbove` are seen; a sensor always sees its own `close` share of its radius.

start._doc: What the landing brings (the HQ starts nearly empty, ROAST 2.5).

economy._doc: M3. The dispatcher and producers run every `every` ticks. A carrier leaves only with at least `minLoad` (or everything there is, when a camp is full). `inputBatches` = how many batches of input a producer keeps in its pool. Idle carriers walk home after `idleHome` ticks. `pathBudget` caps the cells one route search may open. `refund` = share of the cost left as a pile when you demolish (undo within `undoTicks` refunds everything). Camps stop when their own store is full (OUTPUT lamp). A lamp must stay lit `jamDebounce` ticks before the teletype hears of it, and the same lamp for the same reason is not reported again within `jamRepeat` ticks.

town._doc: M7 (js/sim/town/). The town step runs every `every` ticks. The landing party (`startPop`) sleeps in the HQ (`hqBeds`); `start` is the food and water it brings. Every `mealEvery` ticks each home eats `foodPerMeal` and drinks `waterPerMeal` per person from ITS OWN pool (a home outside every yard ring has a pantry the porters fill: `pantryMeals` meals of it). A home that misses `leaveAfterMeals` meals in a row loses one person (they walk out). Every `arriveEvery` ticks, if there is a free bed, the base holds `bufferMeals` meals for everyone, morale is at least `minMorale` and no enemy is within `dangerR` cells of a home, a group of up to `groupMax` settlers starts walking in from the map edge (edge points sampled every `gateStep` cells, the `gates` nearest the HQ); the teletype hears of the town each time it passes a multiple of `tellEvery` people. Jobs: food and water buildings (`staffFirst`) are staffed first, then the rest nearest a home first. Morale: each home scores the five inputs (`morale.weights`) minus `smokePenalty` when smoke over it is at least `smokeAt` (quarter-res density); `light` = the coarse light field at the home is at least `lightAt`; `commons` = within a Commons' `serves` radius. The base needle is the residents' average, it moves `morale.rate` a step toward its target, and work speed = low + (high - low) x needle. `chimneys`: puffs of smoke (density `amount`, radius `r`) from running producers and lived-in houses every `every` ticks. Town size feeds M4's Noise: one source at the middle of the homes, `noisePerPerson` x people, at most `noiseMax`. Farms grow in `farm.stages` (share of a batch: tilled, young, ripe) and replant `farm.replant` burnt cells a step.

defence._doc: M4 (js/sim/defence/). `difficulty`: `raid` scales every raid's size, `grace` = ticks before any nest may send its first raid, `hqLoss` = what losing the home HQ means (end = game over; cripple = the HQ is crippled for `crippleTicks`: half sight and half speed, then it is patched back to `crippleHp` of full). `hp`: hit points of a building that is not a tower = footprint cells x `perCell` (at least `min`), the HQ `hq`. `noise`: what each running building puts into the Noise field (quarter-res, 0-255), falling by `fall` a quarter-cell and by `forest` more through woods (forest soaks it up); a blast adds `blast` x power for `blastTicks`; the town adds town.noisePerPerson a person (M7). `glow`: the same for the Glow field (M6 feeds it: spells, the refinery, batteries; Wall V adds its own). `raid`: `warn` = ticks between a raid forming and it leaving the nest (the predicted path is drawn all that time); `giveUp` = a raid that has not reached anything in this many ticks goes home; `fieldBudget` = flow-field cells settled a tick; `margin` = cells round the nest-to-target box the field covers; `refresh` = ticks between field rebuilds while anything blocking changed; `aggro` = cells an enemy turns aside for a damageable thing; `chew` = what one hit point of wall or building costs in the field, in cells of walking (so a raid goes round a wall when the way round is shorter than chewing through); `farReach` = with nothing in reach, a raid goes for the nearest thing it may damage out to this many times its reach; `maxEnemies` caps the map. `fire`: hit points a building or section loses each `every` ticks for every burning cell of it. `blast`: damage at the centre of a blast per unit of power (falls to zero at the edge), `enemy` multiplies it for enemies. `crew`: a porter or cart has `hp` hit points; a lost one is replaced at its home after `respawn` ticks. `threat`: the Noise/Glow fields are sent to the scope every `fieldEvery` ticks.
